lines.zh: 裂隙人的肉，还挂我腰上。
lines.en: Rifter flesh still hangs at my waist.

lines.zh: 缝里的光在动，是你在动。
lines.en: The light under the door moves, that's you.

lines.zh: 我的脚已经踩到你的影子边。
lines.en: My foot already touches your shadow's edge.
When the rift opens, I crawl out.
Leave the light on. I see fine.
Don't look back, I'm walking.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了裂隙边的一块水晶。
lines.en: I crushed a crystal by the rift.

lines.zh: 裂隙旁边，我站了很久了。
lines.en: I have stood by this rift a long time.
The shape by the rift is me.
I have counted every brick in this hall.
Six steps, five, keep count right.

lines.zh: 我的脚没有落地的声音。
lines.en: My feet make no sound landing.
I stand in the corner, like the wall.

lines.zh: 裂隙的边上，我数着裂缝。
lines.en: At the rift edge, I count the cracks.
I count how often the lamp goes out.
The wall breathes by my ear.
I wait for someone to blow out the lamp.

lines.zh: 裂隙边上，我一直在这儿守着。
lines.en: I keep watch at the rift's edge.

lines.zh: 午夜裂隙边，你睡得着吗。
lines.en: By a midnight rift, can you even sleep?
On the far side of the rift, I have seen you.

lines.zh: 裂隙人的肉，咬起来很老
lines.en: Rifter flesh is tough to chew
By the rift, I'm always waiting.
The four hundredth moth died.
Midnight's light never changes.

lines.zh: 呼吸是什么感觉，我忘了。
lines.en: What breathing felt like, I have forgotten.
By the rift, I'm always there.
I have remembered your scent for days.
By the rift, I have always been here.
Within one step, I can reach you.
Your face does not match your shadow.
Are you looking for the door, or me?
You were the one knocking last night.

lines.zh: 柱子后面那点黑，瞒不过我。
lines.en: That dark behind the pillar doesn't hide you.

lines.zh: 裂隙边站着的身影，就是我。
lines.en: The shape by the rift. That's me.
We stand like this, who moves first?
I see you, Rifter.
Let me see which part of you is missing.

lines.zh: 亮的东西在午夜很危险。
lines.en: Bright things are dangerous at midnight.
Your shadow is afraid before you.
Being seen by you pleases me.
I prowl along the rift's edge.

lines.zh: 裂隙边上，我又站出来了。
lines.en: By the rift, I step out again.

lines.zh: 你抬头的角度我学得会。
lines.en: I can learn the angle of your head.

lines.zh: 你转身的样子我记住了。
lines.en: I remember how you turn.
Even a rifter feels pain.

lines.zh: 裂隙的风把话吹散了，我没听清。
lines.en: The rift wind scatters words; I miss them.
A piece of my flesh falls, cold.

lines.zh: 我的肉掉下来，还是热的。
lines.en: My flesh falls away still warm.
I will remember this.

lines.zh: 我的肉，裂隙另一头的人爱吃。
lines.en: Those beyond the rift eat my flesh.
My blood is grey.
Blood dripping is too loud.

lines.zh: 我的影子替我接了一下。
lines.en: My shadow took that blow for me.

lines.zh: 裂隙的光刺痛，反而清醒。
lines.en: The rift's glare stings, and wakes me up.

lines.zh: 让我拿一会儿，就一会儿。
lines.en: Let me hold it, just for a while.
What are you doing with it?

lines.zh: 这形状我在裂隙边摸过。
lines.en: I felt this shape beside the rift.

lines.zh: 名字换一样东西，可以吗？
lines.en: My name for something — deal?
It is warm in your hand.
It is more interesting than you.
This cloth is the color of a crack.
Put it by my feet and walk away.
I am not hungry. I just want it.
Share the light in your hand with me.

lines.zh: 裂隙边缘的风，我站得很稳。
lines.en: At the rift's edge, my footing is firm.
Don't come close, I stick to people.
We were not meant to touch.
The room's fault. Not yours.
Where you touch me turns black.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的影子里了，凉吧。
lines.en: You stepped into my shadow, cold, isn't it?

lines.zh: 裂隙的边缘，不该有接触。
lines.en: At the rift's edge, there should be no contact.

lines.zh: 裂隙人的肉，你也想尝尝？
lines.en: Want a taste of rifter flesh?
I forgot how to apologize.
Your shoulder is so warm.
Let me see your face first.

lines.zh: 裂隙边上，我等着下一个。
lines.en: By the rift, I wait for the next one.
I do not need a heartbeat.
By the rift — come with me.
See? We are alike.
Midnight never dawns, stay.

lines.zh: 影子总会找到另一个影子。
lines.en: A shadow always finds another.
I smell your fear. It is fine.

lines.zh: 两个影子叠在一起就好。
lines.en: Two shadows overlapping is enough.
They call us rifters.
Your thing belongs to me now.
I've stood by the rift a long while.
I tuck this button into my chest.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块裂隙碎片，收好。
lines.en: I pick up a rift shard and pocket it.
This little thing's shadow moves.
Seven, one is missing.
I will leave it here.

lines.zh: 裂隙人的肉，我留着路上吃。
lines.en: Rifter meat, kept for the road.

lines.zh: 别看我捡东西，这块肉归我。
lines.en: Do not watch me pick it up; this meat is mine.

lines.zh: 裂隙边的东西，我挑一件。
lines.en: By the rift, I pick just one.
The rift is right behind you.

lines.zh: 我把你的脚印记在手心。
lines.en: I keep your footprints in my palm.

lines.zh: 裂隙边的土，替我记下了你
lines.en: The dirt by the rift remembered you for me
The shadow's shape matches.
The light on you is too bright.
Your voice sounds like mine.
The shadow beside the rift is me.

lines.zh: 你一回头我就退到墙里。
lines.en: Turn around and I sink into the wall.
By the rift, I smell you.

lines.zh: 我追了三条街才认出你。
lines.en: I chased three streets before I knew you.
The rift will remember your name.

lines.zh: 裂隙的风，把气味送到我这儿。
lines.en: The rift wind carries your scent to me.
Hold still. Let me look.

lines.zh: 永夜的寂静里，我听得很清。
lines.en: In the endless silence, I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 你落脚，我就跟着挪一步。
lines.en: Your foot lands, and I shift a step too.
By the rift, the shadow moves first.

lines.zh: 你的脚印现在一深一浅。
lines.en: Now your footprints are uneven.

lines.zh: 这具身体，只能递给人一块肉。
lines.en: This body can only hand over meat.
Your soles ring on the stone.

lines.zh: 裂隙关上了，我照样守在这。
lines.en: The rift closed; I still guard here.

lines.zh: 你喘气的时候漏了半拍。
lines.en: Your breathing skips half a beat.

lines.zh: 我身上这层皮，是从裂隙撕的。
lines.en: This hide was torn off the rift.

lines.zh: 别跑那么快，裂隙就在后面。
lines.en: Don't run so fast, the rift is behind you.
I have stood at every corner.

lines.zh: 是你先走进我的地盘的。
lines.en: You walked into my ground first.
There is no window at the hall's end.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经贴到墙上了。
lines.en: Your shadow is already on the wall.
I walk slow, but you can't go around.
Behind the rift there's no way out.
Your lace is loose, no rush.

lines.zh: 你掉了一只鞋，我捡起来了。
lines.en: You dropped a boot; I picked it up.
The third door on the left is fake.

lines.zh: 裂隙人的影子在墙上晃。
lines.en: The rifter's shadow wavers on the wall.

lines.zh: 你身后的光，把裂隙照亮了。
lines.en: The light behind you lights up the rift.

lines.zh: 裂隙边，我一直站在这里。
lines.en: By the rift, I never left.
The shape by the rift is me.
The rift wind cuts grass and flesh alike.
One, two, too late.
Rift sand is under my nails.
My hand covers your mouth.
I finish whispering at your ear.
Rifter flesh drops on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从裂隙里伸出半只手。
lines.en: I reach half a hand out of the rift.
I pin your shadow first.

lines.zh: 裂缝一开，我的手就伸出来。
lines.en: The rift opens, and my hand comes out.

lines.zh: 裂隙人的肉，就是我自己的。
lines.en: Rifter flesh is my own flesh.

lines.zh: 骨头响得整个楼道都听见。
lines.en: Your bones echo down the hall.

lines.zh: 影子里伸出手，搭上你肩。
lines.en: A hand comes out of the shadow onto your shoulder.
Just one hit, it will be quick.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头还有别的影子。
lines.en: More shadows wait at the hall's end.
Something in the wall answers me.

lines.zh: 裂隙开了，我就在旁边等。
lines.en: The rift opened. I wait beside it.
The cold around me spreads.
The rift opens; I go first.

lines.zh: 又是这个世界，又是裂缝。
lines.en: This world again, and the rift again.
Only in the dark do I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 裂隙那边，又有人在低声说话。
lines.en: Someone by the rift is whispering again.
Only one living soul tonight.

lines.zh: 我从裂隙里挤出来，肉还热着。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the rift, my flesh still warm.

lines.zh: 血的味道从楼上飘下来。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts down.
I nod the way people do.
I stand at the doorway, still.
The footsteps you hear are empty.

lines.zh: 我的名字，落在裂隙里了。
lines.en: My name fell into the rift.

lines.zh: 这块地砖裂过我踩的那道。
lines.en: This tile cracked where I stepped.
My shadow lags, wait for it.
I slip out of the rift.
The rift closes under my feet.
Even a rifter's flesh burns.
I fall from the ceiling into the hall.
Water pours into my shadow.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的轮廓炸散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my outline.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，那个洞不流血。
lines.en: The arrow passes; the hole doesn't bleed.
Your light burns me.
Hunger thins my shadow.
Lightning crawls in my bones.

lines.zh: 裂隙下面，什么都不接住。
lines.en: Below the rift, nothing catches you.
